resources.string: Real situations, like studying on a commute or falling asleep to a book, solved by combining features. Read aloud like any book; remove it any time.

Each chapter is one recipe: a real situation, what you need, and the steps, using the names you see on screen. If you can\'t find something, search for it in the Library: search finds settings and actions too.\n\nThe same recipes are on the ListenLock website, with new ones added over time. This book comes with the app and needs no internet.
